mechanics.name: Teamwork: Full Circuit
mechanics.currentEffect: For each other Survivor repairing a Generator with you, the Good Skill Check zone increases by 15/20/25%. While repairing with at least one other Survivor, you repair 5% faster.
activation: Repair a Generator with at least one other Survivor for the 5% repair-speed bonus.
Each additional Survivor repairing with you increases the Good Skill Check zone.
Ends/deactivates when: Bonuses end when you stop repairing with the other Survivor or Survivors.
mechanics.patchNote: Latest live balance change (9.4.0): Introduced; no later material live balance change located in the official notes checked.
mechanics.plainEnglishSummary: Cooperative repairs are faster and have a larger Good Skill Check zone for each teammate on the Generator.
specialInteractions: The skill-check zone increase is per other Survivor repairing that Generator with you.

editorial.summary: While repairing with at least one teammate, repair 5% faster and enlarge Good Skill Check zones by up to 25% for each other Survivor present.
useCases: Gain a small cooperative repair bonus on generators the team deliberately stacks.
Make Good Skill Checks easier for newer teammates or difficult Skill Check situations.
Pair with other co-op repair perks in coordinated objective builds.
counters: Provides no repair bonus while working alone.
Five percent does not erase the strategic cost of unnecessary generator stacking.
Larger Good Skill Check zones provide little value to players already hitting Greats consistently.
pros: Can help less experienced players avoid misses.
cons: Skill Check enlargement can actually be undesirable in Great-focused builds.
Outclassed by stronger cooperative repair options.
analysis: Teamwork: Full Circuit sits near the tier boundary because a permanent 5% repair bonus while cooperating is useful, but not transformative. The perk only exists while another Survivor is on the same generator, and Survivors often create more map pressure by repairing separately.

The enlarged Good Skill Check zone is primarily accessibility rather than high-level power. Newer players may appreciate the safer checks, while Hyperfocus users and confident Great-check players receive almost no benefit from that half.
Friendly Competition ranks higher because its 10% reward can follow the participating Survivors onto later generators after they split. Full Circuit requires continued co-op repair to keep paying.

It remains a functional objective perk, especially in SWF builds intentionally designed around shared generators. As a general queue choice, the slot has too little value whenever you are working alone.
editorial.verdict: A straightforward co-op repair perk with a low ceiling. Full Circuit helps when you were already going to stack the generator, but should not be the reason you stack it.
